text: 星帅尔公告，公司于2026年11月5日收到控股股东、实际控制人、董事长楼勇伟提议回购公司股份的函。提议以集中竞价交易方式回购公司A股，回购资金总额不低于人民币1亿元（含）且不超过人民币1.5亿元（含），回购价格不高于董事会通过回购股份决议前三十个交易日公司股票交易均价的150%，具体以董事会审议通过的回购方案为准；资金来源为公司自有资金或自筹资金，回购期限为董事会审议通过回购方案之日起3个月内。回购股份拟用于维护公司价值及股东权益，在披露回购结果暨股份变动公告12个月后采用集中竞价交易方式全部出售；如未能在回购实施完成之日起36个月内用于上述用途，未使用
text_en: Xingshuaier announced that on November 5, 2026, the company received a letter from controlling shareholder, actual controller, and chairman Lou Yongwei proposing a share repurchase. The proposal is to repurchase the company's A-shares through centralized bidding, with a total repurchase amount of no less than RMB 100 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 150 million (inclusive), and the repurchase price not higher than 150% of the average trading price of the company's shares over the 30 trading days before the board resolution approving the repurchase, subject to the repurchase plan approved by the board; the funds will come from the company's own funds or self-raised funds, and the repurchase period will be within 3 months from the date the board approves the repurchase plan.
